title: CA-511 residual: the timeout-nesting guard hardcodes a 3-phase multiplier with no coupling to the three invoke_claude call sites, and the wave7 pin asserts the literal source string -- adding a fourth phase re-inverts the nesting and bypasses CA-452's handshake with a green suite

CA-481(c) residual: the new cross-file trap sweep never asserts that INT/TERM/HUP arms exit after cleanup, and its last-quote signal parser is blind to unquoted handlers (trap cleanup_wave6 EXIT, live at wave6-smoke.sh:37), so the cleanup-then-resume class can return green

edm-init scaffolds a directory tree under set -e with no trap and no unwind; a failure or signal before edm-state init at :165 leaves a state-file-less directory that the :125 existence guard permanently refuses, with a recovery hint (edm-state get) that cannot work

CA-521 was closed by its documentation route (EDM-HELP :25-31, CLAUDE.md hooks row, test-pinned with a positive control at wave7-smoke.sh:7314-7368); the code gap is unchanged but now satisfies filter clause 1 -- recommend re-disposition to accepted rather than carrying it open

The check-then-create TOCTOU between :125 and :130 is real but was adjudicated Not Actionable in round 10 (non-finding 9); honoring that disposition, and finding 3 is scoped to the partial-failure axis so it does not reopen it

_edm_reclaim_stale_lockdir derives its stale-aside name from $$ while CA-396 moved the sibling flock marker to BASHPID for that exact class; safe only because _EDM_TRAP_DEPTH is process-global, so change it in the same commit if cross-lockbase nesting is ever made legal
Round 10's N1 (untrapped mkdir-to-trap lock window, :1407 to :1507) is now self-healing rather than open: CA-480's hoisted age-gated reclaim collects a pidfile-less lockdir after 1 second

The CA-479 block is bash-3.2 safe under set -u: only ${#_pass_cands[@]} is evaluated when the array can be empty, both [@]/[*] expansions sit inside the non-empty branch; verified by reading, not executed (no Bash this round)
CA-479's mtime tie-break falls back to glob order when two pass directories share an mtime, but the warning still names every candidate, so the ambiguity is never silent -- acceptable as written

CA-294/CA-375's lock give-up budget asymmetry is RESOLVED, not standing: :1202-1217 single-sources both backends from EDM_STATE_LOCK_WAIT_S with the knob validated beside its default -- round 10's N9 description is stale and should not be carried forward
The CA-471 gate's jq empty check over JSONL re-verified correct: jq's concatenated-value input mode accepts valid JSONL and fails a truncated final line, the intended direction

The CA-479 case covers only the newer-is-fully-backed direction; the inverse (newer is a partial scratch copy, producing an irreversible spurious downgrade per CA-506) has no case, though mtime selection is direction-symmetric

The CI_JOB_TIMEOUT coupling skips silently when the variable is absent or non-numeric (correct outside CI, but on a runner predating the variable the guard is inert with no diagnostic); a one-line notice on the skip arm would make its inactivity observable

Verified clean: the pattern-library lockbase created by update-patterns inside plugins/edm/docs/audit-patterns/ is covered by .gitignore:15 and again shape-anchored at :35-36, so update-patterns leaks no tracked lock artifact into the plugin tree

COVERAGE CAVEAT (CA-130 recurrence #9): delivered without Write and without Bash, so both halves are returned inline, every FIXED verdict is read-derived rather than diff-derived over 0b2f304, and no finding was reproduced dynamically; CA-331/CA-377's run-all.sh request is outstanding for a seventh round

SCOPE CAVEAT: report as unaudited, not clean -- edm-state:1550-3290, :3421-4513, :5060-5486, :5692-6203; edm-validate-prefix/check-grants/check-vocabulary/check-skill-sync/compare-eval/sync-canonical-sections and both shared libs; run-eval.sh outside :395-460; bin/tests beyond the ranges read; remaining skills/agents/docs. CA-056 and CA-059 re-verified intact; CA-027/028/055/062 got no regression check
